changes.why: v0.16.0 removed R.mapIndexed, deprecated since v0.15.0 for addIndex(map) (1a2e129b 'remove functions deprecated in v0.15.x')
v0.16.0 removed R.filterIndexed, deprecated since v0.15.0
v0.16.0 removed R.rejectIndexed, deprecated since v0.15.0
v0.16.0 removed R.reduceIndexed, deprecated since v0.15.0
v0.16.0 removed R.reduceRightIndexed, deprecated since v0.15.0
v0.16.0 removed R.substring, deprecated since v0.15.0 for slice
v0.16.0 removed R.substringFrom, deprecated since v0.15.0
v0.16.0 removed R.substringTo, deprecated since v0.15.0
v0.16.0 removed R.strIndexOf, deprecated since v0.15.0 for indexOf
v0.16.0 removed R.strLastIndexOf, deprecated since v0.15.0 for lastIndexOf
v0.16.0 removed R.eq again (deprecated since v0.15.0; identical replaces it)
v0.16.0 removed R.eqDeep again (deprecated since v0.15.0; equals replaces it)
v0.16.0 ('composable lenses', 2d0b0270) removed R.lensOn with the property-carrying lenses
v0.16.0 removed R.composeL: van Laarhoven lenses compose with R.compose
v0.16.0 removed R.pipeL: lenses compose with R.pipe
the support record for lensOn's bound lens goes with lensOn (v0.14.0 SpecVal precedent)
v0.16.0's lenses are van Laarhoven functions (no l(a) getter, no .set/.map): the record Lens<A, V>(get, set_, map_) becomes the type (V --> Functor<X, V>) -> (S --> Functor<X, S>)

v0.16.0's lens(getter, setter) returns f => s => map(v => setter(v, s), f(getter(s))) instead of a function with set/map properties (lens(g, s)(a) is now a function): the result type changes from the Lens record to the van Laarhoven Lens<S, V, X>
v0.16.0's lensIndex returns a van Laarhoven lens (through lens): new result type, used through view/set/over, whose set also requires the index in range as it runs the getter
v0.16.0's lensProp returns a van Laarhoven lens (through lens): new result type; set now runs the getter, so it requires the key
v0.16.0 makes R.max binary (43b57125): max(a, b) = b > a ? b : a instead of the largest element of a list
v0.16.0 makes R.min binary: min(a, b) = b < a ? b : a instead of the least element of a list
v0.16.0 makes R.maxBy binary: maxBy(f, a, b) = f(b) > f(a) ? b : a instead of a list's element with the greatest key (which skipped list[0] in v0.15.x)
v0.16.0 makes R.minBy binary: minBy(f, a, b) = f(b) < f(a) ? b : a
v0.16.0's propEq(val, name, obj) takes the value first (propSatisfies(equals(val), name, obj)); propEq('b', 2, {b: 2}) went from true to false
v0.16.0's commute is commuteMap(identity) instead of commuteMap(map(identity)): the revealed body passes xs => xs, with the same results
knock-on of the strIndexOf removal: the revealed body finds the first occurrence through split, and the postconditions state it without strIndexOf, with the same results
knock-on of the strIndexOf removal: the revealed body cuts at a prefix occurrence and recurses on the rest instead of calling strIndexOf, with the same results (new postconditions only add)
new in v0.16.0 (@category List): take(n < xs.length ? xs.length - n : 0, xs)
new in v0.16.0 (@category List): drops the longest suffix satisfying pred
new in v0.16.0 (@category List): drop(n >= 0 ? xs.length - n : 0, xs)
new in v0.16.0 (@category List): the longest suffix satisfying fn
new in v0.16.0 (@category List): slices of n elements; n <= 0 throws, so n > 0 is required
new in v0.16.0 (@category List): the first element for each value of fn (R.equals on the values)
new in v0.16.0 (@category Logic): pred(obj[name]), the predicate getting None for an absent property
new in v0.16.0 (@category Function): right-to-left Kleisli composition, compose of chain; binary, over lists
new in v0.16.0 (@category Function): left-to-right Kleisli composition, composeK reversed
new in v0.16.0 (@category Object): lens(Const)(x).value, the focus
new in v0.16.0 (@category Object): lens(y => Identity(f(y)))(x).value, x with f applied to its focus
new in v0.16.0 (@category Object): R.set(lens, v, x) = over(lens, always(v), x); set is a Dafny keyword
support datatype for v0.16.0's lenses: Const (view.js's functor) and Identity (over.js's)
support function: the map of Prelude.Functor (Const keeps itself, Identity applies f), which v0.16.0's lens calls through R.map
